features.title: Homeowner Per-Task Start Price Override Editor
features.description: Let the homeowner override the AI-suggested starting bid price on a per-task basis when reviewing the project scope. The owner sees the AI suggested price next to each task and can set a higher or lower owner_start_price; clearing the override falls back to the AI value. The project's calculated starting bid total is the sum across all tasks of COALESCE(owner_start_price, ai_start_price). This total is what the Owner Bid Summary (feat-owner-bid-summary) and the Contractor Start Bid display (FT-767) consume. Complements FT-767 which only handled the read/display side; this feature implements the homeowner-side write path and the live total calculation in the scope review UI.
